theme: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 × Skate 3

options.title: I MERGED 2 GAMES
options.scene: The creator is a large chest-up cutout in the lower left, natural impressed slight smile, gaze toward the crossover. To the right, original MW2 Ghost performs a large readable ollie with a skateboard directly under both boots. A single continuous landscape transitions from MW2 Rust's dusty steel tower on the left to a bright concrete Skate 3 skatepark on the right, clearly separated yet connected by the skating action. Keep Ghost and the board fully visible. Huge headline across the top, with only the numeral 2 yellow.
options.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished YouTube thumbnail, full-bleed landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is for a video about AI combining Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (the classic 2009 game) with Skate 3. Make the playable crossover instantly clear. NO Minecraft, NO GTA, NO Doom.
Reference role: copy the supplied thumbnail's graphic design language only: huge bold ultra-condensed sans-serif headline, white and selective bright yellow letters, substantial black stroke and tight shadow; sharp high-contrast game-art compositing; strong daylight; saturated but believable color; clean cutout edges; dominant foreground subject and simplified background. Do not copy the Minecraft/GTA subject matter or old headline.
Represent MW2 with its iconic Ghost operator wearing the original skull-pattern balaclava, dark glasses and tactical headset, classic military equipment and/or the Rust industrial desert map with its rusty central steel tower. Represent Skate 3 with a clearly visible real skateboard, authentic natural skating posture and tricks, broad concrete bowls, handrails and the sunny Port Carverton urban skate plaza visual language. Skateboarding is the action; no combat, blood or injuries.
One clear idea and focal point. Readable at phone size. Use the exact specified headline, and only that text. No subtitles, logos, HUD, score counters, tiny labels or watermarks. Keep text inset within frame and clear of faces. Avoid generic tech imagery, excessive glow, muddled collages, duplicate characters, malformed boards, extra wheels, extra fingers, distorted faces. Crisp polished game artwork; not a movie poster or product advertisement.
Image 1 is the source identity photo: use ONLY the real young adult man on its right half. Preserve his exact recognizable face, short tousled curly light-brown hair, blue-grey eyes, skin texture and natural proportions; dark plain shirt. Ignore game footage, room, microphone and text in this identity photo. Image 2 is the graphic style reference. Do not beautify, alter age, or make exaggerated expressions.
